Perception mislocalization: find_pixel rank-1 for "black stove knob" was at (127,45) = the robot arm/base, and the accepted alternative (187,121)->(-0.225,0.213,~0.95) put the gripper down on the black burner disc of the stove plate rather than on the paddle lever (round 10 step 11; final wrist view shows concentric burner rings between the pads, not the paddle), so the knob was never gripped and never rotated; get_grasp_pose also returned no finite 6-DoF candidates twice (round 1 step 12, round 5 step 7, round 10 step 4).

Pick never secured: round-10 pointing was inconsistent (find_by_pointing 'tipped can next to carton' -> [145,186] = the upright red/green can at x=+0.248, step 2/9; second call -> [94,110] unprojecting to z=0.135 above the table, step 9), so grasp_object at [94,110] closed on air (grasp_point z=0.0715, gripper_gap 0.0797, grasped=False, step 4); can left tipped on table, basket empty, 0 budget left.

Reviewer verdict: `blocked` · proposal: `NO_PROPOSAL`
n/a — round 10 succeeded: grasp_object held the bottle (gap 0.0378, holding_visual true), place_object_in(basket, z_offset 0.06) released inside and is_holding returned open (not held).

[TOOL_BUG perception-pixel-frame 2/3] find_pixel/find_by_pointing return pixels in a down-scaled frame (119,138) that unproject_pixel(camera='head') reads in full-res head coordinates: (119,138)->[-0.027,-0.032,0.033] near the robot base while the bottle visibly sits at ~(240,270) of the 512-px head frame; the wrist variant returned [-0.230,0.019,-0.001]. Round 10 therefore produced no motion or grasp, only six more unusable unprojections (steps 4,7).

No transport ever completed: round 10 was wasted on a pixel-scale mismatch — the head frame is 256x256 but was read in 512 display space, and all four marks (u=330/360/390/405, v=315-340, round 10 step 5) sat outside the sensor grid, so unproject_pixel silently clamped them to a constant far point [0.8966, 0.0, 0.65] instead of erroring; no grasp was attempted that round. Across rounds the grasps that did report held were table-level pinches (gap 0.0017-0.0133, e.g. round 2 step 6 grasp_point z=0.0355 with pixel 137,145 = table beside the bottle, round 1 step 6 z=0.0352) and the one real pinch (round 1 step 4, gap 0.0133) was lost during the basket approach ('hold lost after container approach', round 1 step 6, gate 'closed_empty' gap 0.001).

place_object_in's basket approach was unreachable (round 10 step 5: 'could not reach the container approach pose', approach_position_error 0.105 m, ee_pos x=-0.0248 vs target x≈+0.0799) and the carton slipped out of the pads during that failed approach (step 8 is_holding: holding=False, gripper_gap=0.0012, closed_empty); the butter now lies on the table and the basket liner is empty.
